THIRD-PARTY NOTICES for brain-wiki's vendored visualizer builds
================================================================

src/brainwiki/viz/assets/vendor/ contains two minified UMD builds downloaded unmodified
from jsdelivr (see scripts/vendor.lock for URLs and SHA-256 hashes):

  3d-force-graph.min.js  3d-force-graph 1.80.1 (bundles three.js r186 and the packages below)
  force-graph.min.js     force-graph 1.52.0

The minified builds drop upstream license headers. This file reproduces the full
license text of each library and of every package in their runtime dependency tree,
as resolved for those releases from the npm registry. Columns: package, version,
license, and which vendored build(s) include it (3D = 3d-force-graph.min.js,
2D = force-graph.min.js).

Summary
-------

  3d-force-graph        1.80.1     MIT            3D
  force-graph           1.52.0     MIT            2D
  three                 0.186.1    MIT            3D
  accessor-fn           1.5.3      MIT            3D+2D
  @babel/runtime        7.29.10    MIT            3D
  bezier-js             6.1.4      MIT            2D
  canvas-color-tracker  1.3.2      MIT            2D
  d3-array              3.2.4      ISC            3D+2D
  d3-binarytree         1.0.2      MIT            3D+2D
  d3-color              3.1.0      ISC            3D+2D
  d3-dispatch           3.0.1      ISC            3D+2D
  d3-drag               3.0.0      ISC            2D
  d3-ease               3.0.1      BSD-3-Clause   2D
  d3-force-3d           3.0.6      MIT            3D+2D
  d3-format             3.1.2      ISC            3D+2D
  d3-interpolate        3.0.1      ISC            3D+2D
  d3-octree             1.1.0      MIT            3D+2D
  d3-quadtree           3.0.1      ISC            3D+2D
  d3-scale              4.0.2      ISC            3D+2D
  d3-scale-chromatic    3.1.0      ISC            3D+2D
  d3-selection          3.0.0      ISC            3D+2D
  d3-time               3.1.0      ISC            3D+2D
  d3-time-format        4.1.0      ISC            3D+2D
  d3-timer              3.0.1      ISC            3D+2D
  d3-transition         3.0.1      ISC            2D
